subject.title: feat: trace Claude Code CLI model calls

question: Should OpenClaw's model.call contract remain one lifecycle per actual provider request, or intentionally include one synthetic aggregate lifecycle per Claude CLI turn?
rationale: Both designs are implementable, but they produce materially different GenAI request counts, latency distributions, and token semantics for diagnostics consumers; code review cannot safely choose that public telemetry meaning.

options.title: Use a dedicated CLI-turn span
options.body: Preserve request-scoped model.call semantics and export the observable Claude lifecycle as a distinct turn or harness operation linked to the same trace.

options.title: Expand the model.call contract
options.body: Accept aggregate Claude turns as model calls, then update the event contract, consumer naming, documentation, metrics expectations, and compatibility coverage to make the mixed semantics explicit.

recommendation.title: Use a dedicated CLI-turn span
recommendation.body: Preserve request-scoped model.call semantics and export the observable Claude lifecycle as a distinct turn or harness operation linked to the same trace.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent work on the CLI runtime makes this the best available person to route the diagnostics-contract decision to, though ownership history is incomplete.
